tools.name: get_studio_info
tools.description: Retrieve official studio information for Bump to Baby 4D Scans in Montana, Pretoria including physical address, operating hours, contact phone, WhatsApp, email, family viewing amenities, and 12+ week elective scan policy.

tools.name: get_scan_packages_and_pricing
tools.description: Retrieve live elective pregnancy ultrasound and sonar packages, prices in South African Rand (ZAR), recommended pregnancy weeks, and digital inclusions (HD digital photos and video clips sent directly to phone, heartbeat listening, free 4D rescan guarantee).

tools.name: get_gestational_guide
tools.description: Get recommended pregnancy week windows for each scan package (12+ weeks minimum rule, 14–16+ weeks for Gender Determination, 24–32 weeks for 4D/5D HD-Live facial imaging) and preparation tips for optimal ultrasound clarity.

tools.name: check_booking_availability
tools.description: Check real-time appointment slot availability on a specific YYYY-MM-DD date at Bump to Baby in Montana, Pretoria. Returns studio trading status and open appointment times.

tools.name: prepare_booking_link
tools.description: Verify pregnancy gestation eligibility (12+ weeks) and optional slot availability, then generate a direct pre-selected booking URL on bumptobabysa.co.za where the parent confirms their slot (pay on arrival by card or cash).

tools.name: get_studio_faqs_and_policies
tools.description: Retrieve official answers to frequently asked questions covering family/sibling attendance, 12-week minimum gestation policy, HD digital photo/video delivery to phone, non-diagnostic disclaimer, free 4D rescan guarantee, and free rescheduling.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_studio_info · Private data: get_studio_info · Public sink: get_studio_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_studio_info · Private data: get_studio_info · Public sink: get_studio_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
